integrity: Analytical proof and exact finite checker; finite checks are not an infinite proof. Self-review only, with no independent audit, outside certification, or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent exponential clocks only; local ratios uniformly O(1/n) for the spatial Poisson limit. The geometric-rate perfect-ranking cutoff additionally assumes the ratio tends to zero. No nonexponential, correlated, or arbitrary-separation extension is proved. Potential unindexed earlier equivalent results remain a priority risk.
title: Spatial Poisson errors and the sharp exact-ordering transition for exponential races
